baseSizePolicy: Reviewed official PDF footprints in command-center-mapping.json; missing sizes block application.
limitations: Units, weapons, abilities and tactical cards come from the Command Center DB. Base sizes use reviewed mappings from official card PDFs; no general rules are imported.
Manual placement only; army-list import and roster legality are not implemented.

Default profiles remain unchanged until an upgrade is selected. Selected passive HP, weapon and ability changes use WDS option mappings and blue differences. Conditional bonuses are green bracketed alternatives; paid and reactive abilities require activation.
All units are exposed, including faction-restricted and summoned units; eligibility is manual.
Shields are displayed separately from HP; shield loss/healing is manual.
Source completeness against current official releases is not established.
Warhall client compatibility/loading has not been verified.

attributes.Effect:
Set a Psionic Storm token Within 10" and Line of Sight of this Unit. This token is not removed if this Unit is Destroyed. At the End of each Phase, set a Psionic Storm Blast Template on the centre of this token. For each Unit that has at least one model whose base is partially covered by the template, roll 3 dice, plus 1 additional die for each model in that Unit whose base is partially covered. For each result of 5+, that Unit suffers an effect depending on the current Phase:
Movement Phase: NON-LETHAL DAMAGE (1).
Assault Phase: 1 Damage. 
If multiple effects trigger at the End of the Assault Phase, resolve them in the order specified in Part 8.9.4.
Target one Friendly Unit Within 12". Until the End of the Round, that Unit is eligible to make an Evade Roll against any attacks targeting it.
